question: How many edits were made to the Wikipedia page on Antidisestablishmentarianism from its inception until June of 2023?

history.name: Orchestrator

Team: Assistant (tools), WebSurfer (browser), FileSurfer (local files). Plan: confirm inception date, use the Wikimedia API to fetch revisions up to 2023-06-30, page through results, and count revisions. Cross-check if possible.

history.name: Orchestrator

history.name: Assistant
history.content: Use MediaWiki API: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&titles=Antidisestablishmentarianism&rvlimit=max&rvprop=ids|timestamp&rvdir=newer&rvend=2023-06-30T23:59:59Z&format=json. Note rvlimit=max returns up to 500 revisions per request; use 'continue' with rvcontinue to iterate until exhaustion. Count 'revisions' array entries cumulatively. Timezone is UTC; rvend includes revisions up to the specified timestamp.
